title: University announces 2026 recipients of annual teaching awards
summary_en: The University of Kansas has announced 15 faculty members from the Lawrence and KU Medical Center campuses as recipients of KU’s annual teaching awards. They will be honored at a public reception Oct. 13 at the Jayhawk Welcome Center.
title_cn: University announces 2026 recipients of annual teaching awards

title: Polish naturalists saved European bison from extinction, research reveals
summary_en: In a new scholarly article, Nathan Wood, associate professor of history at the University of Kansas, describes how after soldiers and poachers killed the last free European bison, Polish naturalists worked with international organizations following World War I to revive the species from the few animals scattered on estates and zoos across the continent.
title_cn: Polish naturalists saved European bison from extinction, research reveals

title: KU student-designed mural reflects community, belonging in Watson Library
summary_en: KU Libraries collaborated with students from the Department of Design for a new mural in The Kettle in Watson Library. The public is invited to an opening reception at 4 p.m. Sept. 24 to celebrate the work and partnership.
title_cn: KU student-designed mural reflects community, belonging in Watson Library
